shortDescription.default: Tenant-wide SharePoint maintenance and notification banner system.

longDescription.default: SharePoint Maintenance Banner is a tenant-wide SPFx Application Customizer that displays centralized, list-driven notification banners above the SharePoint site header. It supports priority, scheduling, severity colors, dismissible notices, and linked detail pages.

features.title: SharePoint Maintenance Banner Application Extension
features.description: Deploys the SharePoint Maintenance Banner custom action with ClientSideComponentId association.
